D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/LinearForests/.name: D5.S3.Combinatorics.Graph.LinearForests.DirectedForestPathOrder.component_path_order
D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/LinearForests/.signature: theorem component_path_order [Finite V] (E : V → V → Prop) (hout : Relator.RightUnique E) (hin : Relator.LeftUnique E) (ha : ∀ x, ¬ TransGen E x x) (A : Component E) : ∃! e : Fin (Nat.card (ComponentFiber E A)) ≃ ComponentFiber E A, ∀ i j, E (e i).1 (e j).1 ↔ i.1 + 1 = j.1
